_description: Golden CO SNAP household as a request against the PUBLISHED per-program artifact us-co-snap.compiled.json. Derived from co-snap-golden.engine-request.json by rewriting every dataset input from the composed-program namespace (axiom:co-snap-fy-2026#input.*) onto the durable legal id of the provision that owns the slot, per the engine's {module_target}#input.{slot} convention.

_provenance.added_reason: snap_countable_earned_income=1200 — the artifact treats this as an input where the composed program derived it, and the certified household definition says the $1,200 monthly income is EARNED. Under 7 CFR 273.10(e)(1)(ii)(A), 1200 - 240 (20% earned-income deduction) - 209 (standard deduction) = 751; the raw excess shelter amount 900 - 375.5 = 524.5 rounds up to 525; and statutory snap_net_income is therefore 751 - 525 = 226.
_provenance.dropped_reason: 41 entries named slots that do not exist in the per-program artifact's input surface (composed-program-only aggregation inputs: llc_s_corporation_*, training_allowance_*, wioa_*, vista_*, current_household_income, employee_wages_received, striking-member income, sick/vacation/bonus pay). Listed in the 2026-07-25 receipt.
_provenance.eligibility_limitation: No categorical inputs were added in this refresh. The certified household definition does not say whether either member provided or applied for an SSN, so it cannot justify the 7 CFR 273.6 inputs needed to certify snap_eligible=holds. On the pinned artifact and released engine this request returns snap_eligible=not_holds and the eligibility-gated allotment 0.
